{{Quote|That wizard's just a crazy old man.|Owen Lars about Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref>}}
'''Wizard''' was a term used by various cultures that generally described an individual with a connection to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. These [[Force Adept]]s came from cultures or Force traditions that were different from organizations such as the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="RPG-Core">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook]]''</ref>

Wizard could also be used as slang to describe an individual. [[Owen Lars/Legends|Owen Lars]] referred to [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] as a "wizard," but equated that with Kenobi being a crazy old man.<ref name="ANH" />
